tagline: Hacker News: feeds, foldable threads, reader mode, bookmarks
description: A read-only Hacker News client for e-paper. Six feeds (Top, New, Best, Ask, Show, Jobs) paged by content height, comment threads you can fold by tapping a byline, a reader mode that strips the linked article down to text, bookmarks, read/unread tracking, three text sizes and a dark theme. Everything is rendered by a Cloudflare Worker from the Algolia HN API; the device only draws.

changelog.notes: First release: feeds, comments with folding, reader mode, bookmarks, read tracking, settings, dark theme, landscape layout.
